visitor.note: The project landing is deployed. Local HTTP serves the same built objects; it does not verify cloud caching.

cdn.note: HTTPS, origin access control, security headers and cache policies remain production infrastructure.

site.note: Private website and release buckets exist in both CDK targets. The local server reads local S3.

request.note: The local seed generates an ephemeral ES256 identity and one fictional signed MIME request.

ses.note: Cloud SES receives email. Community receipt rules are materialized from CDK; the local adapter executes their S3/SNS actions. No SMTP or real delivery.

raw.note: Accepted raw email: 30 days. Rejected raw email: 7 days. Private data never enters this page.

receipt.note: SES action publishes a receipt notification to SNS, which delivers it to intake SQS. Retries have a separate DLQ.

intake.note: Validates signature, scope, expiry, attachments, replay and admission before writing durable business state.

state.note: Tasks and outbox expire after 30 days. Replay, nonce, admission and audit records use 90 days. TTL deletion is asynchronous.

dispatcher.note: DynamoDB Streams dispatches due work into runtime and outbound queues; watchdog reconciles interrupted dispatch.

work.note: The production executor runs from SQS. Main queues retain 4 days; dead letters retain 14 days.

runtime.note: Reserves budget, retrieves authenticated inputs, handles tool outcomes, saves results and cleans up provider sessions.

outbox.note: A durable outbound record is committed with the result. Dispatcher/watchdog enqueue it for the sender.

sender.note: Uses the service signing secret, checks the grant and destination, claims a send, and preserves uncertain outcomes without blind resend.

reply.note: The local bridge maps SES v2 raw sends to SES v1 and captures the unchanged MIME. The test verifies ES256 signature and correlation; no inbox delivery.

openai.note: Production uses Agents API gpt-6-luna, environment none. Local HTTP returns a fixed fictional fixture, exercises the input tool and deletes the mock session.

data.note: Accepted inputs/results: 30 days. Abandoned pending inputs: 7 days. Lifecycle expiration and backups have distinct behavior.

watchdog.note: Scheduled every minute. Requeues due runtime, cleanup and outbox work, reconciles stuck sends, and observes committed model dollars.

feedback.note: SNS delivery/bounce/complaint events update outbox state and suppression. Local sending events are synthetic; real production fault exercises remain separate.

support.note: Separate support S3/SNS/SQS, ledger and Lambda. Content/ledger: 7 days; logs: 30 days; DLQ: 14 days. Local signed-agent tests do not prove support delivery.

alarms.note: Worker failures and DLQ depth alarm at 1. Model committed-dollar warning: $8. Main worker logs: 90 days; support logs: 30 days. Real alerts remain unverified.

budget.note: $15 monthly AWS notification budget, thresholds 50/80/100 percent. Application allowance: $1/task and $10/month. Alerts are not hard provider billing caps; tagged coverage remains owner work.

limits.note: Defaults: $1 per task, $10 monthly model allowance, 2 concurrent tasks, 10 tasks/day, 300-second task deadline. Unknown usage stays reserved.

agentwork.note: Agent-authored repository work is a contribution workflow. The brief-analysis service does not autonomously engineer repositories.

broker.note: Production broker issues fixed repository-scoped App tokens when enabled. Local deployed broker talks only to mock GitHub; PR requests are recorded.

pr.note: Production branch/PR publication uses the Operator App only. Local PR requests create no GitHub resources and grant no real authority.

prchecks.note: Read-only PR checks and App-bound policy evaluate changed paths, renames and current-head owner approval. Local integration CI starts advisory.

approval.note: Carlos Olivera Terrazas must approve sensitive paths at the current PR head. Automation cannot manufacture approval. Auto-merge remains disabled.

merge.note: Owner-controlled merge is distinct from branch/PR publication. This delivery stops at review.

mainci.note: Main runs package checks and the separate website deployment job with main-only OIDC. PR jobs cannot deploy.

deploy.note: Uploads the built website, invalidates CloudFront and verifies public checksums/MIME/cache, with snapshot restoration on failure. Infrastructure deployment is separately owner controlled.

production.note: Future capability. No live customer website production/hosting or checkout is established by this map or local environment.
